description: Figure 15, titled "Token Ratio (TR)," is a grouped bar chart that compares the token generation efficiency of three different models across six different tasks. The horizontal axis lists the tasks: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis represents the Token Ratio (TR), with values ranging from 0 to 1.00. For each task, there are three bars representing the models: "RedWhale (our)" (dark blue), "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" (light blue), and "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)" (light gray). The chart shows that the "RedWhale (our)" model consistently produces the fewest tokens, resulting in a TR value below 0.60 for all tasks, with a value of 0.42 on PT-EVAL. The "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" model produces more tokens, with a TR value of 0.46 on PT-EVAL. The "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)" model serves as the baseline, producing the most tokens, with a TR value of 1.00 for all tasks, as indicated by the labels on top of each bar. The average TR across all tasks for "RedWhale (our)" is 0.57, for "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" is 0.61, and for "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)" is 1.00.
